description: Dependency updates, per ADR-0102. Renovate opens the pull request, and the CI gate decides. It merges nothing.
The nix manager and the weekly lock file maintenance keep flake.lock current, so no pin goes stale.

packageRules.description: A major version is a decision, so it is proposed alone and never joins a group.
Minor and patch updates of the pinned inputs and Actions come in one pull request.
Held at 3.x: postcss depends on nanoid ^3. The root override only lifts the 3.x line to a patched release. A major breaks postcss.
Promotion writes the tags of first-party images, per ADR-0111. These images have no tag for Renovate to read.
The chart and the controller image share one registry path. Chart tags have no v prefix, and image tags have one. So the chart ignores every image tag.
The Codeberg registry refuses an anonymous tag list. data.forgejo.org serves the same images and digests, so Renovate reads the tags there.

customManagers.description: The forge and runner kits pin the release they install on a machine, per ADR-0116. A marker comment above each pin names its image.
